native_review.summary: The agent successfully completed all three user requests: changing the shipping address on order #W5056519 to match order #W8277957, modifying the Makeup Kit item on #W5056519 to skin tone dark / Brand A, and cancelling order #W5995614 for 'ordered by mistake'. The agent authenticated the user via email, checked order statuses, obtained explicit confirmations, and used the correct payment method and reason. The user made no factual errors and followed the simulation guidelines. The only issues were minor policy violations by the agent: making multiple tool calls at once in turn 6, and combining user-facing text with tool calls in turns 16 and 22. These did not affect the final outcome.

errors.reasoning: The agent made three tool calls (get_user_details and two get_order_details) in a single turn while also sending a user-facing message. The policy explicitly states that the agent should make at most one tool call at a time and should not respond to the user and make a tool call simultaneously.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have issued a single tool call, waited for its response, then issued the next tool call, and should not have included user-facing text in the same turn as the tool calls.

errors.reasoning: The agent sent a user-facing message ('I can help with that. Let me look up the available options...') and made a tool call (get_product_details) in the same turn, violating the policy that the agent must not respond to the user and make a tool call at the same time.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made the tool call without including a message to the user, or responded to the user first and then made the tool call in a separate turn.

errors.reasoning: The agent sent a user-facing message ('Now, let me check the status of order #W5995614 before processing the cancellation.') and made a tool call (get_order_details) in the same turn, again violating the policy that the agent must not send a message and make a tool call at the same time.
errors.correct_behavior: The agent should have made the tool call without a simultaneous user-facing message, or separated the message and tool call into distinct turns.

auth_classification.reasoning: The agent requested the user's email address for authentication, looked up the user ID, and confirmed the account details before proceeding with account-specific actions. Identity verification was successfully completed.
